modifications: Added a Qwen4-only ordinary decay producer that casts a and dt_bias to fp32 before addition and softplus; Qwen3.5 keeps the existing compute_g producer.

Changed Qwen4 fused decode, batched decode, out-projection candidate, verify, catchup and replay-derived sources to compute the dynamic decay input and softplus in float32 before the recurrent state update.
Preserved Qwen3.5/Agnes fused decode and verify source arithmetic through explicit family branches/derivation.
Did not adopt Splash's bf16 storage type or chunk-boundary rounding law; mlx2's existing optional fp16 state remains per-token rounded and namespace-separated.
